name: NZ National Health Index (NHI) Data Protection
description: Detects and masks New Zealand National Health Index numbers present in LLM request and response payloads. Covers both the legacy AAANNNC format and the new AAANNAX format introduced July 2026. Enforces Privacy Act 2020 Principle 5 security safeguards within AI-mediated data flows.

compliance.title: Storage and security of personal information
compliance.description: An agency that holds personal information shall ensure that the information is protected by reasonable security safeguards against loss, unauthorised access, use, modification, disclosure, or other misuse.

compliance.title: Trustworthy AI characteristics in organisational policy
compliance.description: The characteristics of trustworthy AI are integrated into organisational policies, processes, procedures, and related practices. This policy operationalises the privacy-enhanced trustworthy AI characteristic by enforcing automated detection and masking of regulated health identifiers in AI data flows.

compliance.title: Sensitive Information Disclosure
compliance.description: LLMs may inadvertently expose confidential data—including regulated health identifiers—through training data memorisation or direct prompt injection. This policy mitigates LLM06 by intercepting NHI numbers at the gateway layer before they enter or leave LLM request/response payloads.

rules.name: NZ NHI Number Detector
rules.description: Matches both the legacy NHI format (AAANNNC: 3 uppercase alpha [A-HJ-NP-Z] + 4 digits) and the new NHI format (AAANNAX: 3 uppercase alpha [A-HJ-NP-Z] + 2 digits + 2 uppercase alpha [A-HJ-NP-Z]). Both formats are exactly 7 characters. I and O are excluded from all alpha positions to avoid confusion with 1 and 0.
